entities.summary: Abdou Moumouni University, formerly the University of Niamey from 1974 to 1994, is a public university based in Niamey, the capital of Niger. The main campus is situated on the right bank of the Niger River. Historically, its students and faculty have been involved in protest movements in the capital. Université Abdou Moumouni is a university in Africa, established in 1971-09-01. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
